description: Closed per-field exemption registry for zh/conformance/encoding.md 4.0.1. A closed object that carries a complete content-addressed typed ref (an id_kind_registry special form marked content_addressed, with a pattern that is exactly that one form) already carries the suite and every digest octet of the referenced bytes, so any sibling digest property in that object is a forbidden wire mirror unless this registry states the distinct preimage it commits to. Rows are keyed by (schema file, json path of the properties object, digest field). content_addressed_refs must equal the current set of in-scope content-addressed ref properties in that object so a later ref addition forces a fresh ruling. Every row is a ruling: there is no undecided kind.

registry_rules.candidate_scope: Every properties object in spec/v1/artifacts/schemas whose members, after $ref resolution, include at least one string pattern that is exactly one ak:<kind>: form of a content_addressed special form with a 64-hex digest payload (unions that also admit UUID, Event or DID forms are outside the gate by construction) and at least one string pattern of the shape ^(sha256|blake3):[0-9a-f]{64}$.
registry_rules.row_rule: Each row exempts exactly one digest field. preimage MUST name the bytes the digest commits to and why they differ from every listed content-addressed ref. spec_anchor MUST cite a spec/v1 prose path or heading anchor inside arkret-spec; the registry never references another repository and never carries an undecided row.
registry_rules.retained_mirror: proof.event_digest inside the enclosing Event's producer/admission proofs is the only content digest that v1 deliberately retains next to the Event identity; it is registered here as a distinct_preimage row against the signer evidence refs and remains governed by encoding.md §3.1.

exemptions.preimage: SHA-256 of the decoded 32 raw Ed25519 public-key octets, so a verifier can index and compare the runtime key without parsing any DTO, JWK, multibase or hex spelling; accepted_commit_id addresses the RealmCommit that made the authorization effective, a different object

SHA-256 of the decoded 32-byte Ed25519 runtime public key, so the runtime can compare it against its own key without parsing evidence; signer_resolution_evidence_ref addresses the canonical signer-evidence root, a different object
SHA-256 of the decoded 32-byte Ed25519 runtime public key; signer_resolution_evidence_ref addresses the complete authenticated signer-resolution evidence root
Digest of the caller-signed erase confirmation for this backup series; authority_commit_id addresses the RealmCommit, not the confirmation
Digest of the prepared transaction plan the coordinator froze before the terminal step; authority_commit_id addresses the RealmCommit, not the plan
Digest of the canonical security-transaction request bytes; authority_commit_id addresses the RealmCommit that anchors the erase, which is a different object
Digest of the bytes owned by this Blob metadata resource; thumbnail_blob_ref addresses separately derived thumbnail bytes

Digest of the private final stream-head manifest the old Station hands over; none of handoff_id, snapshot_ref or change_commit_id addresses that manifest, and the manifest is deliberately absent from the public bundle
Digest of the active control/update key or governance key set head; the receipt id is SHA-256(canonical_json(receipt_claims))
Digest of the Organization DID log head at version_id; the receipt id is SHA-256(canonical_json(receipt_claims))
Digest of the active control/update public key at version_id; the receipt id is SHA-256(canonical_json(receipt claims))
Digest of the service DID log head at version_id; the receipt id is SHA-256(canonical_json(receipt claims))
